subject: [Invite] SF Autumn AI Leaders Dinner, 10/30 @ Spruce
text:
Hi [NAME],

My co-founder, [SENDER], is hosting a dinner in SF for AI leaders later this
month (Thurs 10/30) for ~20 Founders, CTOs and Heads of AI working on
multimodal AI use cases. I saw you're in the Bay Area and been working in
perception from some time at both Koko Labs and now [COMPANY], so
wanted to personally invite you.

We've booked a private room at Spruce, starting at 6.30pm with good food
and drink, and plenty of time to network (no slides, no set agenda). Guests
will include leaders from Agility Robotics, Thinking Machine Labs, Robot
(Kiwibot), Serve Robotics and more, so expect lively conversations on
autonomous systems, embodied AI, and the future of multimodal model
deployment.

If Encord is new to you, we're a multimodal (video, image, LiDAR and more)
ML dataops platform (YC turned Series B scale up). We work with Boston
Dynamics to early stage startups to frontier labs (Thinking Machine Labs)
to help them deploy models faster while saving time and cost across the ML
pipeline.

Let me know if you're interested and I'll save you a spot - more than happy
to share full details.

subject: [NAME] - Vision AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just watched the SOLV demo - pretty cool staff you are building on edge.
Very similar to [COMPANY], many AgriTech/Drone companies we work with
are building vision models for farming use cases.

Teams like Carbon Robotics & Aigen (farming automation on the ground) and
Zeitview & Buzz (aerial inspection) came to us when the sheer volume of
video/sensor data became too much for internal/open source tools to handle.
We help them automate annotation at scale with model-assisted labeling,
HITL review, workflow automation, and model evaluation.

Quick context: Encord is a data development platform for computer vision
and multimodal AI (image, video, 3d point cloud). We just released the
world's largest multimodal AI dataset yesterday! We're venture backed, $50M
raised Series B, and supporting 200+ AI teams to date.

Curious if you're seeing similar data bottlenecks at [COMPANY]. Let me
know if you are open to a quick chat next Tue to Thu mornings PT.
